<thought>Carbon shows a clear M+1 peak (~6.7 % of the monoisotopic peak), matching the expected ~1.1 % per carbon for ~6 carbons. No characteristic M+2 patterns of Cl, Br, or S are observed, so those elements cannot be definitively identified. Thus the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
